verdict.rationale: v0 connects a project to GitHub so its code lives in a repository with branches, CI and pull requests (v0-docs-2, v0-docs-39, v0-docs-31). It can also import existing GitHub code into a chat (v0-docs-27), which makes a local-editor workflow via git plausible. The 'Fix Conflicts' option (v0-docs-26) hints that diverging edits are reconciled, but no doc says that changes pushed from a local editor sync back into the v0 chat or project. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a local-edit → push → v0 picks up changes round trip, any local CLI or dev-sync tooling, and hands-on or community corroboration of a local workflow.
